'''Klatooine''' was the [[Temperature/Legends|arid]] [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the [[Klatooinian/Legends|Klatooinian]] [[Species/Legends|species]]. It was within the [[Si'Klaata Cluster/Legends|Si'Klaata Cluster]], under [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] control. It was covered with [[Desert/Legends|deserts]] and, to a lesser extent, savannas.

==Geography, flora and fauna==
The [[pak'pah]] fruit was found nowhere else in the galaxy, possibly because of wintrium in the soil.

It was home to the [[Derelkoos Desert]], the location of a fissure that spurted a fountain of liquid [[wintrium]]. No technology was allowed one kilometer around this [[Fountain of Ancients]], which the Klatooinians revered as a holy site.

Most buildings were built over wells to prevent shortage of [[Water/Legends|water]] on the planet.

The [[Lesser Houdoggin]], in addition to [[Klatooine paddy frog/Legends|paddy frogs]], a Hutt delicacy, came from this world.
==History==
[[File:Klatooinian-DC.png|thumb|left|150px|A Klatooinian]]
The [[Planet/Legends|planet]] was taken over by the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutts]] under the [[Treaty of Vontor]] in [[25,100 BBY]]. Klatooine was ruled by the [[Council of Elders (Klatooinian)|Council of Elders]]. The Hutts, however, controlled all Klatooinian activities offworld.

Klatooinians became a very useful [[slaver/Legends|slave]] species for the Hutts, and the planet became dominants within the local cluster.<ref>''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref>

During the [[Galactic War]], a [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Klatooine paddy-frog plantation|plantation]] planned on stealing the annual paddy frog harvest to sell them discreetly at a markup as delicacy without enraging the fellow Hutts.<ref name="Mission" />

In [[44 ABY]], the Treaty of Vontor was revoked, and a [[Slavery/Legends|slave]] [[Liberation|revolt]] broke out on the world. However, a team of [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] negotiators led by [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa Solo]] helped the rebels organize themselves and gain Klatooine admission into the Alliance.

{{Planet-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The PC game [[Star Wars: Rebellion (video game)|''Star Wars: Rebellion'']] mistakenly places Klatooine in the "Dufilvan sector" (a misspelling of the true [[Dufilvian sector/Legends|Dufilvian sector]]), which is actually located in the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]].

The name of the planet is most likely a reference to ''"Klaatu barada nikto,"'' a phrase which originated in the 1951 film ''The Day the Earth Stood Still.''
